mainTopic: The words of the פסוק about a כהן גדול and the dead, the משנה's list of impurities that make a נזיר shave, and רבי יהודה's objection to סומכוס's version
overview: This amud opens by finishing an earlier discussion about a כהן גדול. Each word of the פסוק "עַל כׇּל נַפְשׁוֹת מֵת לֹא יָבֹא" teaches a separate case: the unrelated dead, relatives, and a רביעית of blood that came from two dead people. Then a new משנה lists the kinds of טומאת מת that make a נזיר shave. It explains that he becomes טמא from them by touching, carrying, or being under one roof (אוהל). A barley-size bone is different: it counts only for touching and carrying. For all of these, he shaves, is sprinkled on the third and seventh days, loses his earlier days, and starts counting again only after he is pure and brings his קרבנות. The גמרא then tells a story. After רבי מאיר died, רבי יהודה barred his students, but סומכוס pushed his way in. סומכוס quoted רבי מאיר's version of the משנה, which lists both a whole מת and a כזית of a מת. רבי יהודה angrily asked why a whole מת needs to be listed at all, since if a כזית makes him shave, a whole מת surely does. The answer comes on the next amud.

steps.title: Each word of the verse teaches a separate case
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא shows how each phrase in "עַל כׇּל נַפְשׁוֹת מֵת לֹא יָבֹא" covers a different case for the כהן גדול: people who are not his relatives, his own relatives, and a רביעית of blood that came from two dead people together.
steps.simpleTranslation: "On any" teaches about distant people. "Dead" teaches about relatives. "Bodies" (plural) teaches about a רביעית of blood that came out of two dead people, which makes things impure through a tent. This is because the פסוק says: "He shall not go in to any dead bodies."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes an earlier discussion about the כהן גדול. It reads the פסוק word by word, and each word adds a case where he may not become טמא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: "עַל כׇּל" covers the dead who are not related to him. "מֵת" covers even his close relatives. The plural word "נַפְשׁוֹת" teaches that blood from two people joins together to make a רביעית, and that amount is enough to cause טומאת אוהל.

keyTerms.meaning: Literally 'to take out'; here it points to the specific case this word is needed for
Distant people, meaning dead people who are not his relatives
Close relatives
A quarter-log of blood, the amount of blood from a dead person that makes things טמא
Tent or roof; the kind of טומאה that spreads to everything under the same covering

steps.confusionAlert: Here the word לְאַפּוֹקֵי does not mean these cases are allowed. Each word is needed to teach that the כהן גדול may not become טמא in this case too.

phrases.english: "On any" — teaches about distant people,
phrases.notes: Literally 'to take out.' Here it means this word is needed to cover this case.

phrases.english: "dead" — teaches about relatives,
"bodies" — teaches about a quarter-log of blood
that came out of two dead people,
which makes things impure through a tent,

phrases.aramaic: שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״עַל כׇּל נַפְשׁוֹת מֵת לֹא יָבֹא״.
phrases.english: as it is said: "He shall not go in to any dead bodies."

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes a derivation that started earlier on the דף, before this section begins
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Each word of the פסוק adds a case: the unrelated dead, relatives, and a combined רביעית of blood from two dead people, which causes טומאת אוהל.

steps.title: The list of corpse-impurities that make a nazirite shave
steps.stepSummary: A new משנה lists the sources of טומאת מת that make a נזיר shave and start his נזירות again.
steps.simpleTranslation: משנה: For these impurities a נזיר shaves: for a corpse; an olive-size piece of a corpse; an olive-size amount of corpse fluid; a full ladle of corpse dust; the spine; the skull; a limb from a corpse; a limb from a living person that has the proper amount of flesh on it; half a קב of bones; and half a לוג of blood.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה begins. It gives a list of the corpse-related items that are serious enough to make a נזיר shave.
steps.deeperAnalysis: These are the stronger forms of טומאת מת. Many of them come with an exact amount: a כזית, a ladle-full, half a kav, or half a log. The list sets the limit of which impurities fully break a נזיר's count.

keyTerms.meaning: Shaves; the נזיר shaves his hair because his נזירות was broken by טומאה
An olive-size amount
Fluid that comes out of a corpse
A ladle-full of decayed corpse dust
A limb cut off a living person
Half a kav of bones (a measure of volume)

steps.whyThisMatters: This list sets the standard for when a נזיר loses his days. Later, the גמרא works with the items that are on it and the items that are not.

phrases.english: MISHNA:
For these impurities the nazirite shaves:
for a corpse,
and for an olive-bulk of a corpse,
and for an olive-bulk of corpse fluid,
and for a full ladle of corpse dust.
For the spine, and for the skull,
and for a limb from a corpse,
and for a limb from a living person
that has a fitting amount of flesh on it,
phrases.notes: This covers both limbs, the one from the dead and the one from the living.

phrases.english: and for half a kav of bones,
and for half a log of blood.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new משנה on a new topic
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A נזיר shaves for these listed sources of טומאת מת, each at its set amount.

steps.title: How he becomes impure: touching, carrying, or being under the same roof
steps.stepSummary: The משנה adds that he shaves whether he touched, carried, or was under one אוהל with these items. A barley-size bone, though, counts only for touching and carrying.
steps.simpleTranslation: And he shaves for touching them, for carrying them, and for being in a tent with them. And for a bone the size of a barley grain, he shaves for touching it and for carrying it.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה explains the ways a נזיר can catch טומאה from the items on the list. Then it gives one item that works in only some of those ways.
steps.deeperAnalysis: All the listed items make him טמא through מגע (touch), משא (carrying), and אוהל (being under the same roof). The barley-size bone is different. It makes him טמא only by touch or carrying, not by אוהל.

keyTerms.meaning: Touching
Carrying or moving it
Being under the same covering, or covering over it like a tent
A bone the size of a barley grain

steps.confusionAlert: The barley-size bone still makes him shave. It just does not spread טומאה through a roof.

phrases.english: And for touching them and for carrying them
and for their tent.
phrases.notes: Being under one roof with them, or him and the item covering each other like a tent.

phrases.english: And for a bone the size of a barley grain
for touching it and for carrying it.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְעַל מַגָּעָן וְעַל מַשָּׂאָן וְעַל אֲהִילָן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains the ways the items listed in step 2 pass on טומאה
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The listed items make a נזיר shave through touch, carrying, and אוהל. A barley-size bone does so only through touch and carrying.

steps.title: What happens after: shaving, sprinkling, and starting over
steps.stepSummary: For all of these, the נזיר shaves and is sprinkled on the third and seventh days. He loses his earlier days and starts counting again only after he is pure and brings his קרבנות.
steps.simpleTranslation: For these the נזיר shaves. He is sprinkled on the third and the seventh days, he cancels the earlier days, and he does not start counting until he becomes pure and brings his offerings.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה lays out the full result for a נזיר who became טמא from one of these items.
steps.deeperAnalysis: There are four results. He shaves. He goes through the sprinkling of פרה אדומה water on the third and seventh days. All the days he already counted are lost (סותר). His new count starts only after he is pure and has brought his קרבנות.

keyTerms.meaning: Sprinkles; the sprinkling of פרה אדומה water to purify from טומאת מת
Cancels the earlier days he already counted
His offerings, brought by a נזיר who became טמא

steps.whatToRemember: Only the impurities on the משנה's list fully break a נזיר's count. For these he shaves, is sprinkled on days three and seven, loses all his earlier days, and restarts only after he is pure and has brought his קרבנות.

phrases.english: For these the nazirite shaves,
and is sprinkled on the third and on the seventh days,
and he cancels the earlier days,
and he does not begin to count
until he becomes pure
and brings his offerings.

steps.triggerLanguage: עַל אֵלּוּ הַנָּזִיר מְגַלֵּחַ וּמַזֶּה בַּשְּׁלִישִׁי וּבַשְּׁבִיעִי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the results for all the impurities listed in steps 2 and 3
steps.mimraCoreRuling: For these impurities the נזיר shaves, is sprinkled on days three and seven, loses his earlier days, and restarts his count only after he is pure and has brought his קרבנות.

steps.title: רבי יהודה bars רבי מאיר's students, but סומכוס forces his way in
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא tells that after רבי מאיר died, רבי יהודה did not want רבי מאיר's students in his study hall, yet סומכוס pushed in anyway.
steps.simpleTranslation: The גמרא begins. The Rabbis taught: After רבי מאיר died, רבי יהודה said to his students: Don't let רבי מאיר's students come in here. They are troublemakers. They don't come to learn תורה; they come to overwhelm me with הלכות. Still, סומכוס pushed and came in.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא starts with a story that sets the scene for a debate about our משנה. It is setting up the next move, where סומכוס will quote a teaching.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהודה was worried that רבי מאיר's students would come only to trap him with tricky questions. סומכוס, one of those students, came in anyway. This tension explains why רבי יהודה reacts so sharply in the next steps.

keyTerms.meaning: Passing away, death
Troublemakers, people who argue to provoke
To overwhelm me, to beat me down

phrases.english: Gemara:
The Rabbis taught:
After the death of Rabbi Meir,
Rabbi Yehuda said to his students:

phrases.aramaic: אַל יִכָּנְסוּ תַּלְמִידֵי רַבִּי מֵאִיר לְכָאן,
phrases.english: Do not let the students of Rabbi Meir enter here,
because they are troublemakers,
and they do not come to learn Torah,
rather, they come to overwhelm me with halachos.
Sumchos pushed his way and entered.

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: אַחַר פְּטִירָתוֹ שֶׁל רַבִּי מֵאִיר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens the גמרא on the new משנה with a ברייתא story that sets the scene.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רבי יהודה barred רבי מאיר's students as troublemakers, but סומכוס entered anyway.

steps.title: סומכוס quotes רבי מאיר's list of impurities for a נזיר
steps.stepSummary: סומכוס quotes רבי מאיר: a נזיר shaves for these טומאות, for a מת and for a כזית from a מת.
steps.simpleTranslation: סומכוס said to them: This is how רבי מאיר taught me: For these טומאות the נזיר shaves: for a dead body, and for an olive-size piece of a dead body.
steps.whatsHappening: סומכוס repeats the teaching he learned from רבי מאיר about which טומאות make a נזיר shave. This sets up רבי יהודה's attack in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: סומכוס quotes only the opening of רבי מאיר's list, which matches the start of our משנה: a whole מת, then a כזית of a מת. Notice that the bigger item (a whole body) is listed next to the smaller one (a piece). That is exactly what רבי יהודה will pick on.

keyTerms.meaning: He taught me (as a set teaching)
The size of an olive, a common minimum amount in halacha
Shaves; a נזיר who becomes טמא shaves his hair

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר לָהֶם, כָּךְ שָׁנָה לִי רַבִּי מֵאִיר:
phrases.english: He said to them: This is how Rabbi Meir taught me:
phrases.notes: "He" is סומכוס, speaking once he got inside.

phrases.english: For these impurities the nazir shaves:

phrases.aramaic: עַל הַמֵּת, וְעַל כַּזַּיִת מִן הַמֵּת.
phrases.english: for a dead body, and for an olive-size piece of a dead body.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לָהֶם, כָּךְ שָׁנָה לִי רַבִּי מֵאִיר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Now that סומכוס is inside, he quotes the teaching he brought from רבי מאיר.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רבי מאיר's version: a נזיר shaves for a מת and for a כזית from a מת.

steps.title: רבי יהודה objects: listing the whole body is unnecessary
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהודה gets angry and argues that if a כזית of a מת makes a נזיר shave, then a whole מת obviously does, so mentioning it is pointless.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יהודה got angry and said to them: Didn't I tell you this: Don't let רבי מאיר's students come in here, because they are troublemakers? If he shaves for an olive-size piece of a dead body, then for a whole dead body, isn't it all the more so?!
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יהודה attacks the wording סומכוס just quoted. He says the list wastes words by mentioning a whole מת.
steps.deeperAnalysis: His logic is a simple כל שכן: the smaller amount (a כזית) already causes shaving, so the larger amount (a whole מת) surely does. Since a teaching should not include obvious, useless words, he sees the quote as proof that these students only come to make trouble.

keyTerms.meaning: Became angry
All the more so; if the smaller case is true, the bigger case surely is

steps.confusionAlert: רבי יהודה is not saying a whole מת doesn't make the נזיר shave. Of course it does! He is only saying it was obvious, so there was no need to list it.
steps.whyThisMatters: This sets up the question the סוגיא now has to answer: what does the extra word "על המת" add that a כזית does not already cover?

phrases.english: Rabbi Yehuda became angry and said to them,
Didn't I tell you this:

phrases.aramaic: אַל יִכָּנְסוּ תַּלְמִידֵי רַבִּי מֵאִיר לְכָאן,
phrases.english: Do not let the students of Rabbi Meir enter here,
because they are troublemakers?
If he shaves for an olive-size piece of a dead body,
then for a whole dead body, isn't it all the more so?!

steps.triggerLanguage: עַל כַּזַּיִת מִן הַמֵּת מְגַלֵּחַ — עַל הַמֵּת לֹא כׇּל שֶׁכֵּן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the wording of the teaching סומכוס quoted in step 6.
steps.kashyaTarget: The phrase "על המת" in the list סומכוס quoted from רבי מאיר.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Since a כזית of a מת already makes the נזיר shave, a whole מת surely does (כל שכן), so listing it is extra and useless.
